original: [subhāsiyagāhāsaṅgahō]
[॥ namaḥ sarasvatyai ॥]
laṅkā layā palāsā vasantamāsammi laddhamāhappā
analyzed: laṅkā layā palāsā vasanta māsammi laddha māhappā

original: nivvāhiūṇa sīyaṁ pacchā kaliyārayā jāyā // SubhāGāSaṁ.1

vārēu jā samatthā maha intaṁ mahuyarajuvāṇaṁ // SubhāGāSaṁ.2

original: pavaṇuddhuyapallavakarayalēhi vārēi māhavī bhasalaṁ

original: garuyattaṇassa kō māmi! maruyaō ettiyaṁ puṇa bhaṇāmi

original: pāē dhuvanti nissēsataruyarā parimalakahāē // SubhāGāSaṁ.5

original: pāsaṭṭhiyā vi dīsanti nēya rōrā dhaṇaḍḍhēhiṁ // SubhāGāSaṁ.6

original: sūrāyavapapphuṭṭantakaṇayakandoṭṭarēṇupiṅgaṅgā
analyzed: sūrā yava papphuṭṭanta kaṇaya kandoṭṭara ēṇu piṅgaṅgā

original: daṁsaṇamittēṇaṁ ciya māṇasahaṁsā kalijjanti // SubhāGāSaṁ.7

original: nisuṇantā vi hu nisuṇanti nēya rajjaṁ samāsajja // SubhāGāSaṁ.10

original: aṇahuntā vi hu huntīē hunti, huntā vi janti jantīē

original: ō! jīē samaṁ nīsēsaguṇagaṇā jayaü sā lacchī // SubhāGāSaṁ.11

original: andhāriūṇa vayaṇaṁ virasaṁ rasiūṇa māmi! khatthēhi
analyzed: andha ariūṇa vayaṇaṁ virasaṁ rasiūṇa māmi khatthēhi

original: taha jalaharēhiṁ dinnaṁ paüraṁ pi jalaṁ alaṁ tēhiṁ // SubhāGāSaṁ.14

original: mahiuṁ mahōahiṁ mahumahō vi jaṁ suyaï tassa ucchaṅgē
analyzed: mahiuṁ mahōahiṁ mahumahō vi jaṁ tassa ucchaṅgē

original: taṁ ciya nīivirūddhaṁ, ahavā chajjaï samatthāṇa // SubhāGāSaṁ.15

abbhatthiō vi sayavattavaṇasirī haraï jaṁ nisānāhō

analyzed: taṁ tassa nēya juttaṁ ahavā kā lajja sakalaṅkā

original: hōhī balī surindō tuṭṭhēṇa murāriṇā na sandēhō

analyzed: hārū urassa savaṇāṇa kuṇḍalē mēhalā niyambassa

original: nayaṇāṇa puṇō garuē vi ūsavē kajjalasalāyā // SubhāGāSaṁ.21

analyzed: jō jattiyassa atthassa bhāyaṇaṁ sō u tettiyaṁ lahaï

original: vuṭṭhē vi dōṇamēhē na ḍuṅgarē pāṇiyaṁ ṭhāi // SubhāGāSaṁ.22
analyzed: vuṭṭhē vi dōṇamāhē na ḍuṅgarā pāṇiyaṁ ṭhāi

original: uvabhuñjiuṁ na sakkaï riddhiṁ pattō vi punnaparihīṇō
analyzed: uvabhuñjiuṁ na sakkañ riddhiṁ pattō vi punna parihīṇō

original: paüraṁ pi jalaṁ tisiō vi maṇḍalō lihaï jīhāē // SubhāGāSaṁ.23

original: paḍivannapālaṇē supurisāṇa jaṁ hōi taṁ hōu // SubhāGāSaṁ.29

analyzed: ujjhanti dhaṇaṁ chaḍḍanti maṇḍalaṁ pariharanti niyajīyaṁ

original: paḍhamaṁ ciya rōsavasē jā icchā hōi sā na kāyavvā
analyzed: paḍhamaṁ ciya jā icchā hōi sā na kāyavvā

analyzed: kettiya mittaṁ ca dharā maha baliṇū tujjha maggamāṇassa

original: appā na kēvalaṁ ciya ahaṁ pi lahuīkaō kaṇha! // SubhāGāSaṁ.38

analyzed: taïyapayaṁ alahantō sāmarisō kīsa kaṇha maha uvariṁ

original: ettha tuha cciya dōsō maḍahā puhaī kayā jēṇa // SubhāGāSaṁ.39

original: attāṇaṁ ciya duharaṁ jāṇa jaē tēhiṁ kiṁ va jāēhiṁ?
analyzed: attāṇaṁ ciya duharaṁ jāṇa jaē tēhiṁ kiṁ va jāēhiṁ

original: susamatthā jē na parōvayāriṇō tēhi vi na kiñci // SubhāGāSaṁ.42
analyzed: su samatthāḥ jē na tēhi vi na kiñci

original: uvayārō kīraï khalayaṇassa jō phusaï takkhaṇa ccēva
analyzed: uvayārō kīraï khalayaṇassa jō phusaï takkhaṇa ccēva

original: paḍivayaṇasamatthēṇa vi sahiyavvaṁ dujjaṇassa suyaṇēṇa

analyzed: na ya piṭṭhammi nilīṇō vasahassa siriṁ harañ kāō

original: ukkhaṇaï ṇaïniyaïṁ[?]pavaṇō nāūṇa tucchamūlāiṁ

analyzed: mūlīi mahalla tarū garuyāḥ garuyaṁ virūhanti

analyzed: garuyāṇaṁ garuya cciya uvayāraṁ jañ karanti na hu annō

original: kō ulhavēi viñjhaṁ mēhēṇa viṇā palippantaṁ? // SubhāGāSaṁ.48

original: visadalanimmiyadēhō ēsō puṇa dūhavō annō // SubhāGāSaṁ.50

analyzed: muharāo cciya bhannaï jū jassa piō kimattha

original: paṅgaṇayaṁ ciya sāhaï gharassa abbhintaraṁ lacchiṁ // SubhāGāSaṁ.51
analyzed: paṅgaṇayaṁ ciya sāhañ gharassa abbhintaraṁ lacchiṁ

analyzed: jāīsarāiṁ mannā imāiṁ nayaṇāiṁ honti lōyassa

analyzed: daṭṭhūṇa taruṇi sura loṭṭanta vaddha karaṇēhiṁ

original: dīvō vi taggayamaṇō gayaṁ pi tellaṁ na yāṇēi // SubhāGāSaṁ.59
analyzed: dīvū vi gayaṁ pi tellaṁ na

analyzed: ēsō sahī jō sō hiyayaṁ mahilāṇa

original: kāṁi vi karinti! hala sahi!, piyasuraē vēyaṇā kattō? // SubhāGāSaṁ.61

analyzed: rēhaï ciya lambira kēsa hattha kuṇḍala lalanta hāralayā

original: aḍḍhoppaïyā vijjāhari vva purisā''rayē vālā // SubhāGāSaṁ.62

analyzed: bāla khellantayassa jaṁ paḍañ vāri ramaṇīyaṁ

original: guruvirahajalaṇasantāvatāviyaṁ taṁ piyassa ōlhāvaē aṅgaṁ[?] // SubhāGāSaṁ.63

analyzed: jattha sarē majjijjañ sēvaya taruṇīhiṁ tāviyaṅgīhiṁ

original: sālūrātavaṇamayā tattha va dīsanti gayajīvā // SubhāGāSaṁ.64

analyzed: na jāmi khettē sālī khajjantu kīra nivahēhiṁ

original: jāṇantā vi hayāsā pahiyā pucchanti mē maggaṁ // SubhāGāSaṁ.65

analyzed: pattē piya pāhuṇaē kiṁ kāhī duggaō turantō vi

analyzed: andhū maliēhiṁ vi lōyaṇēhiṁ andho cciya varāō

analyzed: guṇiṇū vihava ārūḍhāṇa vihaviṇū guru guṇāṇa na hu kipi

original: annōnnayalahuyayarā girīṇa jē mūla-siharēhiṁ // SubhāGāSaṁ.68

analyzed: addāē va jammi dukkhaṁ na saṅkamaï

analyzed: atthavaṇaṁ jañ hōi hōu kō dōsō

original: jaṁ puṇa muccaï tēō sūrāṇa na ērisaṁ juttaṁ // SubhāGāSaṁ.72
analyzed: jaṁ puṇa muccañ tā sūrāṇa na ērisaṁ juttaṁ

original: pacchābhimuhō vaccaï paharahaō aṁvaraṁ vimottūṇa
analyzed: paccha abhimuhō vaccaï paharahaō aṁvaraṁ vimottūṇa
